beauts|UW T S.why: Ends in UW T S, matching grassroots' key UW2 T S.

brutes|UW T S.why: Ends in UW T S, same key as grassroots.

foots|UW T S.why: Vowel is UH (foot), not UW, so the key UH1 T S differs from UW2 T S.

soups|UW T S.why: Ends in UW P S, but grassroots needs UW T S; P differs from T.
